title: fix(metadata-protocol): duplicatePackage renames a name that is also a field key only at object-reference sites
body:
Fixes #23561
Clause-②: no

## What this does

`duplicatePackage` (`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts`, ADR-0070 D4) renamed a token that is BOTH a prefixed package object's name AND a field key as if it were the object, in free text. A field keyed `dupsrc_customer` on the object `dupsrc_customer` kept its key on the copy, but a copied list view's `columns` and a copied form's `sections[].fields` were rewritten to `dupdst_customer`, a field the copy does not have. Since PR #23559 the list view was refused at the copy (`list-view-field-unknown`). The form copied silently, with a dangling field.

Triage ruling (comment 6181968665), direction B: "Rename such a name only at object-reference sites, never in free text. That extends the landed bare-name policy". C (also renaming the field) is ruled out.

The mechanism: before the free-text regex is built, `duplicatePackage` collects the `fields` record keys of every object row in the source package. A prefixed renamed object name that is also one of those keys is left out of the free-text regex. Such a name is then rewritten only by the existing object-reference path (`REFERENCE_SITES` target `object`: `object`, `reference`, `objectName`, a permission set's `objects` keys, and the rest), which is exactly how a bare object name is already handled. No second mechanism is added, and `reference-sites.ts` is not edited.

- **Scope of "a field key": package-wide.** The set holds a field key on ANY object of the package, not only on the same-named object. For example, a lookup field `acme_customer` on `acme_order` raises the same ambiguity in that order's list view. Package-wide is the superset of the two readings.
- **Consequence of the ruling, pinned:** free text (an object's `description`) naming such an object is now left as stored. A prefixed object that no field key spells is still renamed in free text, as a whole identifier, as before.
- No accept/refuse change beyond the copy no longer refusing that list view.

## Pins (`packages/objectql/src/protocol-duplicate-package-names-in-step.test.ts`, real kernel: ObjectKernel + ObjectQLPlugin, memory driver)

- **New case:** a name that is both a prefixed object and a field key is renamed only at object-reference properties. It asserts:
  - `res.failed` is empty (the list view is no longer refused) and both views are copied;
  - the list-view columns stay `['full_name', 'dupsrc_customer', 'x_dupsrc_customer']`;
  - the form's `sections[0].fields` stay `['full_name', 'dupsrc_customer']`;
  - the object references DO follow the copy: the view `object` and `config.data.object`, two lookup `reference`s, the action `objectName`, and the permission set's `objects` key;
  - the description is left as stored;
  - `engine.insert` through the copied field key lands.
- **Flipped pin, load-bearing:** the landed case-2 assertion that the description reads `Linked from dupdst_customer` now reads the description unchanged, by the ruled semantics. The whole-identifier (left-boundary) rule it also guarded is re-pinned on a new prefixed object with no matching field key, `dupsrc_note`. That case expects `Attached to dupdst_note; see x_dupsrc_note.`, and the field `x_dupsrc_note` keeps both its key and its name. So the guarded surface does not shrink.
- **Negative control:** `dupsrc_note`, an ordinary prefixed object, is still renamed in free text.

**Ablation** (through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`). The anchor `renameMap.has(name) && !fieldKeys.has(name)` went from 1 hit to 0 and was replaced by a marker literal (blob `49c970959c61` to `1ea7b74ba948`). Then: rebuild `@objectstack/metadata-protocol`, and `ablation-dist-preflight` found the marker in 2 built files. The pin file then read `Tests 5 failed | 1 passed (6)`. That is MORE diagnostics than the 2 red cases predicted: the copied list view's `dupdst_customer` column is refused at the copy, so `failed[]` is non-empty and cases 1, 3 and 4 go red as well. Restore: blob == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty, rebuild, `--absent` preflight (marker absent from all 24 built files), then the pin file read `Tests 6 passed (6)`.

## Tests and gates (head `e7a7b375ed`, after merging `origin/main` `26501ae24f`)

- Build: the `@objectstack/objectql` closure was rebuilt after the merge (VERDICT command-exit 0).
- Five duplicate suites (`names-in-step`, `unprefixed-object`, `permission-field-keys`, `objects-key-collision`, `package-lifecycle`): `Test Files 5 passed (5)`, `Tests 30 passed (30)`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol exec vitest run`: `Test Files 246 passed | 3 skipped (249)`, `Tests 20655 passed | 19 skipped`.
- Typecheck: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol typecheck` and `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql typecheck` both exited 0 (`check:test-typecheck: OK`).
- ESLint, a proven narrowing to the 2 touched source files:
  - `--no-inline-config --format json` gives 2 files, 0 errors, 0 warnings.
  - The config never enables type-aware linting (`eslint.config.mjs`, no `parserOptions.project`), so this diff cannot move any untouched file's verdict.
- `@objectstack/spec` `test:repo`: `Test Files 61 passed (61)`, `Tests 1033 passed (1033)`. This was measured at `efed56ba5b`, before the merge. This diff touches no `packages/spec` file.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 69 commands at `e7a7b375ed`. Every exit was captured before any pipe. `--ran` printed: `69 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 68 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED`.
  - The 68 that ran exited 0.
  - NOT MEASURED: `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, exit 3, PREREQUISITE NOT MET. It needs every package's `dist/`, and a full build is outside this card's local scope. CI's `Lint & Repo Gates` runs it.

## Acceptance notes

- **File surface:** the claimed `protocol.ts` region, the sibling pin file in `packages/objectql` (where the family's pins live, see PR #23559), and the changeset. `reference-sites.ts` needed no edit.
- **Recorded only, as the card and triage say:** a view CONTAINER name with no dot (for example `ticket_views`) is still renamed by the prefix swap alone. It is not addressed here.
- **Pull:** as the card measured, no field key equals an object name across the three example apps, so the repro is synthetic.

Changeset: `.changeset/23561-duplicate-object-name-token.md`, `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` `patch`.
